recipe.label: Geometric Facets

traits.medium: flat polygon-like landscape illustration with a restrained color-plane hierarchy
traits.texture: crisp flat planes with no photographic texture or obvious outlines
traits.composition: align large facets with sweeping cloud bands, a low horizon and water reflections
traits.lighting: sunset luminosity expressed through warm and cool color planes

review_checks: flat color hierarchy without photographic gradients
limitations: Raster illustration only; no vector paths or exact polygon topology is supplied.
Palette and fine geometry are prompt guidance and require visual review across a series.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: README style reference; intended use: One reviewed Geometric Facets example for the Art Skill style catalog
Primary request: A wide view across dark gently rippling water toward low island silhouettes beneath an expansive sunset sky. The horizon sits low, with a larger dark headland at the left edge, layered orange, coral, gold and purple clouds and a tiny distant boat near the right horizon.
Style/medium: flat polygon-like landscape illustration with a restrained color-plane hierarchy
Color palette: #E5B973, #C66D58, #9A677D, #454C69, #273840
Materials/textures: crisp flat planes with no photographic texture or obvious outlines
Composition/framing: align large facets with sweeping cloud bands, a low horizon and water reflections; Keep landscape orientation and the original broad framing; one image, no frame or panels
Lighting/mood: sunset luminosity expressed through warm and cool color planes
Requested output target: 1536x1024, opaque background, png; use only supported tool controls
Avoid: real people; copyrighted characters; logos and brand marks; copied artworks; unrequested lettering
Constraints: Keep the original low horizon, open water, dark left headland, low islands and sweeping layered sunset clouds. The sky dominates. Do not add a garden, terrace, trees or a towering central cloud.; No added people, brands, characters, captions or signatures; Use only this source photograph as the composition reference; never mix motifs from the other photos
